def runs_diag(a,b):
    # find matching runs between a and b along diagonals
    out=[]
    na, nb = len(a), len(b)
    for d in range(-nb, na):
        # positions p in a, q in b with q - p = d
        p0 = max(0, d)  # q = p + d >=0 => p >= -d
        p1 = min(na, nb - d)
        p = p0
        while p < p1:
            if a[p] == b[p+d]:
                start = p
                while p < p1 and a[p] == b[p+d]:
                    p += 1
                out.append((start, p-start, p-1+d, d))
            else:
                p += 1
    return out
